usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/serper/search with JSON body {q, num?, gl?, hl?, tbs?, location?, safe?}
quirks: Multiple endpoint variants available on x402.orth.sh: /serper/search ($0.002), /serper/news ($0.002), /serper/images ($0.002), /serper/places ($0.002), /serper/autocomplete ($0.002), /serper/patents ($0.002), /serper/videos ($0.002), /serper/shopping ($0.004), /serper/maps ($0.006), /serper/lens ($0.006 — requires url param not q)

StableEnrich gateway at https://stableenrich.dev/api/serper/news is a separate news-only backend at $0.04/call (also accepts MPP) with defined outputSchema body.news[].{position,title,link,snippet,date,source,imageUrl}
answerBox and peopleAlsoAsk are present when Google returns them — not guaranteed for every query
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.orth.sh/serper/search with {q: string} as JSON body and x402 payment on Base; costs $0.002 USDC per call. The response contains body.organic[] for web results plus optional body.answerBox and body.peopleAlsoAsk. Use num (1-100) to control result count. For news results use /serper/news, for image search use /serper/images, for shopping use /serper/shopping ($0.004), for maps/places use /serper/maps ($0.006). The StableEnrich backend (https://stableenrich.dev/api/serper/news) is news-only but costs $0.04 and also accepts MPP.
